title: AION 2 NotMeter: Setup and DPS Records
description: Install NotMeter on Windows, search AION 2 characters and compare DPS, nDPS and skill damage across similar encounters.
summary: Use NotMeter’s download link, check desktop support for your region and patch, then install Npcap and the tool. Filter comparable encounters and review skill contribution alongside the fight outcome.
quickAnswer: Download from notmeter.com after checking desktop support for your region and game patch. Install Npcap, extract the ZIP and run NotMeter.exe. Compare records with matching boss, difficulty and CP filters.

workflow.title: Make a combat comparison useful
workflow.caption: Compare similar fights, change one build choice and review the outcome.

steps.label: Record conditions
steps.description: Write down service region, patch, tool version, encounter and build.

steps.label: Compare like with like
steps.description: Use several similar attempts and keep the party and task comparable.

steps.label: Change one variable
steps.description: Adjust one skill or build choice so the result remains interpretable.

steps.label: Check the outcome
steps.description: Consider completion, survival and useful party contribution as well as damage.
